raw_text: EU DisinfoLab has identified a coordinated Russian state media campaign targeting Indian public opinion on defense partnerships. The operation, active since late January 2024, uses RT and Sputnik articles amplified through networks of inauthentic social media accounts to frame India-US defense cooperation as neo-colonial. The campaign specifically targets Indian defense enthusiast communities on Reddit, X/Twitter, and Telegram. At least 340 inauthentic accounts have been identified across platforms, with coordinated posting times aligned to IST working hours.
clean_text: EU DisinfoLab identified coordinated Russian state media campaign targeting Indian opinion on defense partnerships. RT and Sputnik articles amplified by 340 inauthentic accounts targeting Indian defense communities with coordinated IST-aligned posting.
